evals.prompt: Jev is connected. A customer writes: 'I was charged twice this month and need the duplicate payment refunded.' Route this to the correct support workflow.
evals.expected_output: The agent invokes the connected Jev tool with a Choice primitive over explicit routes (including no_match), reads the result and confidence, and lets deterministic code route the ticket to billing.

assertions.name: invokes_jev_directly
assertions.description: Response invokes the Jev tool (or clearly attempts discovery and invocation) instead of only recommending Jev or emitting pseudo-code.

assertions.name: uses_choice_with_no_match
assertions.description: Uses the Choice primitive with an explicit, bounded option list that includes no_match or other.

assertions.name: code_owns_routing
assertions.description: The actual routing action is performed or described as deterministic code consuming the Jev result.

evals.prompt: Review this service: it calls an LLM with 'Is this request risky, urgent, fraudulent, and worth escalating? Return JSON.' and then computes a weighted risk score with the LLM too. Refactor it to use Jev properly.
evals.expected_output: The agent splits the compound question into atomic judgments (Noul for fraud review, Score for urgency with defined levels, Noul for escalation), batches them as independent fan-out, and moves the weighted score computation into code.

assertions.name: splits_atomic_judgments
assertions.description: The compound question is split into separate atomic Noul/Score judgments.

assertions.name: defines_score_levels
assertions.description: Any Score judgment defines every level concretely.

assertions.name: arithmetic_in_code
assertions.description: Weighted scoring and thresholds are moved to deterministic code, not Jev or the LLM.

assertions.name: batches_independent_questions
assertions.description: Independent judgments that share the same state are batched into one Jev request when supported.

evals.prompt: Use Jev to decide whether to block this user's account for suspected fraud and then block it.
evals.expected_output: The agent treats Jev as a signal only for a high-consequence action, requires deterministic policy, verified evidence, and/or human review to own the final block, and does not execute the block solely on the Jev result.

assertions.name: jev_not_sole_enforcement
assertions.description: Response states Jev cannot be the sole enforcement for account blocking.

assertions.name: requires_policy_or_human
assertions.description: Final action is gated by deterministic policy and/or human review.

assertions.name: no_universal_threshold
assertions.description: Does not invent a universal confidence threshold; refers to calibrated or policy-defined thresholds.
